# Moonshots

<!-- Generated by scripts/partner-programs.mjs from data/partner-programs.json, data/partner-programs-ai.json, data/partner-programs-motion.json, data/partner-programs-brands.json, data/partner-programs-crypto.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

The partnerships that look impossible. A partnership with IBM or OpenAI sounded out of reach for a small open-source 3D agent startup, and both started the same way: someone checked whether the company had a partner program, and it did. This page takes every household-name company in the sector trackers and names the single most open door into each one, so the next impossible partner is a form away instead of a daydream.

**192 household names tracked.** We already hold 14 programs at 9 of them, 141 have a door open or watchable today, and 51 have no public route yet. Access is scored honestly: 5 is self-serve, 3 is a competitive application, 1 is invite-only or needs a size we do not have yet.

## How to work a moonshot

- **Take the open door, not the front door.** A startup program, an app store, a developer platform, or an open call gets a small company inside a giant; the strategic partnership comes later, from inside.
- **Lead with what already holds.** Acceptance by one household name is the strongest signal to the next.
- **Ask for the promotion on the way in.** The [promotion index](./promotion-programs.md) says which of these doors also come with a blog post, a showcase, or a demo day.
- **Record every attempt.** `npm run programs -- --log <id> --action "..." --status submitted` keeps the chase list honest; a no is data, and most of these reopen on a cadence.
